map.输入各期现金流，按不同折现率扫描NPV，精确定位内部收益率（NPV由正转负的临界: Enter the cash flow of each period and scan NPV at different discount rates to locate the internal rate of return precisely (the point where NPV turns from positive to negative)
map.投资决策中通过扫描多个折现率下的净现值，定位使 NPV 由正转负的临界点，即内部: In investment decisions, scan the net present value at several discount rates to locate the point where NPV turns from positive to negative, which is the internal rate of return.
map.对比不同项目时，用同一组现金流绘制 NPV 随折现率变化的试算表，直观比较收益率: When comparing projects, use the same set of cash flows to build a trial table of NPV against the discount rate and compare returns intuitively.
map.做项目可行性论证或融资方案比选时，将 IRR 与资金成本或基准收益率对照判断是否: When running a feasibility study or comparing financing options, compare IRR with the cost of capital or the benchmark return to judge whether the target is met.
map.五年现金流试算内部收益率: Five-year cash flow trial calculation of the internal rate of return
map.：初始投资 −100000 元，第 1~5 年现金流 25000、30000、3: : Initial investment -100000 CNY, year 1 to 5 cash flows of 25000, 30000, 35000, 30000 and 20000 CNY. At a discount rate of 8% the NPV is about 12312 CNY (positive); at 12% the NPV is about -1414 CNY (negative), so IRR lies between 8% and 12%. By linear interpolation IRR is about 8% + (12312/(12312+1414))x4%, about 11.6%, above the cost of capital, so the project is feasible.
map.IRR 和 NPV 应该看哪个？: Which should you look at, IRR or NPV?
map.NPV 直接给出绝对收益金额，IRR 给出相对收益率便于跨规模对比。互斥且规模差: NPV gives the absolute gain amount directly, while IRR gives a relative return rate convenient for comparing across scales. For mutually exclusive projects with very different scales, look at NPV first; to judge simply whether the return rate meets the target, look at IRR. When cash flows alternate in sign several times, IRR may not be unique and NPV should take precedence.
map.试算表为什么要扫描多个折现率？: Why does the trial table scan several discount rates?
map.IRR 定义为使 NPV 等于零的折现率，无法一步解析求出，需逐档试算：先找到: IRR is defined as the discount rate that makes NPV equal to zero; it cannot be solved analytically in one step and must be trial-computed step by step: first find two adjacent discount rates where NPV is positive at one and negative at the other, then approach the answer by linear interpolation. The finer the scan density, the more precisely the internal rate of return is located.
